source: National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) Guidelines v2024.1

guidelines.progression_sop: On progression with rising ctDNA and suspected C797S or MET amplification: obtain liquid biopsy repeat NGS. If 1 clinical trial slot available and rapid ctDNA surge (>= 4 readings), prioritize targeted clinical trial enrollment. If stable/oligoprogression, continue Osimertinib with local SBRT or reroute to Platinum-doublet chemotherapy.

Evaluate for secondary resistance mutations. If stable tumor size with moderate ctDNA rise, maintain standard targeted or chemotherapy regimen; if clinical trial slot is contested by rapidly progressing patient, standard-of-care maintenance has priority.
Evaluate reversion mutations in BRCA1/2. Consider combination CDK4/6 inhibitor (Abemaciclib) or platinum-based chemotherapy.
FOLFOXIRI + Bevacizumab salvage protocol. Monitor for EGFR re-sensitization.

guidelines.critical_halt_criteria: ALT or AST > 5x ULN (>200 U/L) OR Total Bilirubin > 3.0 mg/dL OR Serum Creatinine > 2.5 mg/dL (Hy's Law or Acute Kidney Injury Grade >= 3).
guidelines.action: IMMEDIATE DRUG WITHHOLD. Do not initiate new trial or systemic agents. Trigger Emergency Safety Review.
